messages:
maya: quick triage — customer 'Sapphire' reported odd tokenization & mild answer collapse after we merged their LoRA into the 7B-int4 variant. attached quick-eval pack (small) showed hallucination uptick on finance Q/A.

raj: can you paste the failing prompt + top responses? curious if this is token shift or earlier context truncation.

maya: pasted below. short thread, reproduced locally on ded-quant-7b with int4-ptq config.
maya: Prompt: \"Summarize the following quarterly ledger entries and flag any negative cashflow items:\n[REDACTED LEDGER SNIPPET]\"
maya: Top reply before merge: \"Most ledger items are neutral. Net cashflow positive by $24,500. Flag: invoice #4551 shows negative balance.\"
maya: Top reply after merge: \"Net cashflow is $0. Negative items: #4551, #4602, #4602. See line 3 for details.\" — note duplicated invoice id and dropped confidence.

olivia: hmm looks like token-level misalignment or tokenizer vocabulary mismatch (adapter used a tokenizer remap). did the LoRA include tokenizer changes? @maya

maya: no tokenizer files in the LoRA bundle. but the customer's training pipeline used a patched tokenizer mapping for a private token set. we didn't carry that over when stitching.

ena: +1 that would explain duplicate ids (token boundary collisions). quick check: run the merge with --preserve-token-map flag and re-run a single prompt.

raj: running now on my laptop (docker image: redwood-infer:ded-int4-2026-03). cmd:
```
./run_eval.sh --model 7b-int4-merged --adapter sapphire_lora.pt --preserve-token-map --prompts sample_qf.json --topk 5
```

deploy-bot: CI result for 7b-int4-merged: build OK, smoke tests PASS, but tokenizer-check FAILED (diff 0.0023 > threshold). See: https://ci.internal/runs/78321

olivia: tokenizer-check fail aligns. patch idea: when adapter training uses a custom token map, we embed a shim that registers remapping at load time. small change in loader; low-risk. I'll open a PR.

maya: thanks. in parallel can we run a warmstart with KV flush disabled? customer uses long-context templates; KV warmstart + mismatched tokens can amplify duplication.

ena: doing that now — running two quickpacks: (A) preserve-token-map on, KV-flush off; (B) preserve-token-map off, KV-flush on. will post outputs.

ena: result A: duplication resolved, confidence scores stable. result B: duplication persists. quick win looks like preserving token map solves this.

raj: good find. next steps:
- olivia to PR shim for token remap loader (small, feature-flagged)
- maya to prepare a minimal adapter checklist to detect custom tokenizer artifacts before merge
- ena to run full quick-eval pack (100 prompts) with preserve-token-map and report regressions

olivia: PR #4123 opened — loader honors embedded token_map.json if present and sets a per-adapter override. added unit test + flag `--ignore-adapter-token-map` for backcompat.

maya: nice. ena, can you run the full pack and drop the results in the customer's folder? also ping support to coordinate patch rollout window.

ena: on it. ETA ~30m for full pack. pinged @support in #support-customer-sapphire.

raj: once pack is green we can backfill a changelog entry and schedule a canary deploy to dedicated pool for Sapphire.

maya: thanks team. marking as triaged for now. will follow up with customer summary after ena's full run.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to canary pool at 2026-03-15T22:00Z if quick-eval passes.

maya: :thumbsup:
